data.name: Nuhah
data.gender_notes: Nuhah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Compassionate and merciful, showing kindness and sympathy to others. The name Nuhah carries the meaning “Compassionate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuhah usually hope their child will grow to embody compassionate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who shows compassion and mercy to others, as described in the Quran.
data.etymology: Nuhah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Compassionate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuhah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: نوحه
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث مشتق من نوح، راحة و آسایش
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوحه یک اسم مؤنث عربی است که از ریشه کلمه نوح گرفته شده است. نوح به معنای راحة و آسایش است. این اسم در فرهنگ اسلامی به عنوان یک نام زیبا و با معنی شناخته می شود. همچنین، در برخی از مناطق، نوحه به عنوان یک اصطلاح برای مرثیه و سوگواره استفاده می شود.

in_urdu.name: نوحہ
in_urdu.meaning: نوحہ کا مطلب ہے راحت، آسائش، یا گریہ و زاری
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوحہ ایک عربی मूल کا مؤنث نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے راحت، آسائش، یا گریہ و زاری۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام کے طور پر جانا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नूहा
in_hindi.meaning: नूहा का अर्थ है आराम, शांति या रोना और 애도
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूहा एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है आराम, शांति या रोना और 애도। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम के रूप में जाना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: نوحه
in_pashto.meaning: نوحه د راحت، آسانۍ، يا ژړا او ماتم معنی لري

in_english.name: Nuhah
in_english.meaning: Nuhah means comfort, rest or lamentation
in_english.long_meaning: Nuhah is a feminine Arabic name derived from the root 'N-W-H', meaning comfort, rest, or lamentation. In Islamic tradition, it is considered a beautiful and meaningful name. The name may also be associated with the concept of mourning or elegy.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nuh in Islamic tradition is associated with the Biblical character Noah. He was a prophet of God who was commanded to build an ark to save his family and animals from a devastating flood that was sent as a punishment for the wicked people of his time. Nuh is regarded as an exemplar of righteousness, obedience, and steadfastness to God's will. The name Nuh also represents the Prophet's unwavering compassion and mercy towards all living creatures, as he not only saved his immediate family but also animals and birds. This compassionate and merciful character has influenced Islamic cultures and societies, especially in the way they address humanity's relationship with nature and animals.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Nuh in Islamic spirituality is an embodiment of God's infinite Mercy and Compassion. It serves as a reminder of the importance of showing kindness and sympathy towards others, regardless of their backgrounds or beliefs. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Nuh, through his compassionate deeds, was granted the Grace and Favor of God. Therefore, carrying the name Nuh is a constant reminder for the bearer to embody the compassionate and merciful qualities of Prophet Nuh. It serves as an inspiration to be kind, compassionate, and sympathetic towards people and animals around us and to strive towards building a just and equitable society.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Nuhah carries profound spiritual symbolism as it is rooted in Quranic tradition. The meaning "Compassionate" symbolizes Compassionate and merciful, showing kindness and sympathy to others.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nuhah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of compassionate.
